impression_before_control_labels: An intimate figure-skating practice photograph: poised, concentrated athlete in a blue dress, a wide active body line and a clear supporting skate with curved ice spray. The image reads as an on-ice athletic moment rather than a static fashion pose.
scene_readability: The support knee, raised trailing skate, open arms, gaze into the route and connected curved trace give a coherent current glide. The pixels support a selected athletic instant; they do not prove a preceding turn sequence, exact jump/spin identity, skill level or outcome.
reference_use: The supplied short dark bob, loose fine fringe, dark eyes and softly tapered facial appearance are broadly recognizable. This is visible appearance guidance, not proof of the person's identity.
artistic_strengths: The face stays clear despite full-body framing.
Supporting blade and connected ice arc provide a concrete movement anchor.
Pale ice separates the boot/mount/runner assembly while the background recedes.
artistic_limits: Only the data-using variant was rendered; visual improvement over the frozen baseline was not tested.
The costume is more embellished than the intended simple practice dress.
The exact preceding technical phase is not provable from one still.

control_comparison.sensual_1: Subtle approachable poise and natural facial detail support the image while the sports action leads.
control_comparison.fetish_0: The equipment reads as athletic hardware rather than a fetish focus.
control_comparison.surreal_0: No added impossible physical or magical effect is visible.
control_comparison.creativity_1: The retained glide and local support refinement remain close to the independent direction.

source_pixel_gates.evidence: The supporting foreground white boot has a dark brown sole band and a raised brown heel visibly above a distinct silver mounting structure; all are in the same support skate near the lower center of the original image.
The silver front and rear mount/stanchion shapes connect the supporting boot sole and heel to one continuous narrow steel runner below them. The open space between boot and runner remains visible.
The bottom runner edge sits on the ice along the curved track, with ice grains beside it. The sole and heel are clearly elevated above the contact surface.

review_boundary: Direct inspection of the actual saved original; the local view_image helper emitted application/octet-stream and the MIME prefix was corrected to image/png for display without changing image bytes.
